interface.longDescription:
Find the right lawyer for your legal matter in Australia.

We collect the right information about your case and match you with a lawyer who fits it. You spend your first conversation on the advice, not on explaining and chasing documents.
defaultPrompt: Help me find a lawyer. I’ve been made redundant and think I was treated unfairly.
I need a lawyer to help recover money a customer owes my business.
Help me find the best lawyer for my case. My landlord won’t fix serious mould in my rental.
